verdict.rationale: LibreChat's own RAG API answers questions grounded in user-uploaded files, and its agents support file handling and secure code interpretation for analyzing data inside the product. That covers the core of getting AI-generated insights from your data. missing for 10: proactive data-derived suggestions (conversation starters are static, agent-configured prompts), in-depth docs on data-analysis workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
